snippet.title: My Time at Evershine | Summer Game Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
It was such an honor to be invited to the Summer Game Fest Nintendo's Play Days event. 

Embark on another grand cozy adventure in the high-quality simulation RPG, My Time at Evershine!  A new world, new faces, and a place to finally call your home. Be sure to wishlist it now, and let’s make a new home together!
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199500/3/

P.S. Please note that the game is still a work in progress. Features and content may change prior to release.
